name: Cadet First Lieutenant insignia on cloth (1/8 in border), regular
size_citation: CAPR 39-1 (3 March 2020) Figure A5-6, dimension drawing (inches read from the figure); border: CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1.1.1 / 5.1.1.1.1.3 (ABU) and 7.1.1.8 (OCP/tactical cap), 1/8 in showing past the widest and tallest point

mounts.uniform: ABU / BDU / blue field coat collar
mounts.rule: regular size (Colonels and Captains may wear miniature), centered 1 in from the FRONT of the collar, 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point (5.1.1.1.1.3, 5.1.2.2.4, 5.2.1.1.1.4). Orientation as drawn: field-grade long points vertical, company-grade circles in a horizontal row (6.2.9.2 / 6.1.10.2.2)

mounts.uniform: OCP / ABU / BDU / blue field / navy tactical cap
mounts.rule: cadet officers only (cadet NCOs and Airmen wear none, 7.1.1.8): centered on the front, 1/2 in from the visor, 1/8 in of blue showing (7.1.1.8, 5.1.2.2.5, 5.2.1.1.1.5, 6.2.11)
dark blue material, centered horizontally, long points of field grade vertical, company-grade circles added horizontally (6.1.10.2.2, 6.1.14.4.2)

cloth_color.basis: sampled from CAPR 39-1 p.136 cloth figure; regulation calls it dark blue
